cards.title: Breakable walls
cards.text: You asked for destructible tiles making up some walls. Which walls, and what breaks them?
cards.why: Breaking walls opens shortcuts and new ways into rooms, for you and for enemies.

options.label: Cracked blocks
options.text: Some thin walls are cracked blocks. Any hit chips them; blasts break them fast.

options.label: Blasts only
options.text: Cracked blocks, but only blasts and dashes break them.

options.label: Room walls
options.text: Rooms' sealed sides are cracked, so you can make your own way in.

options.label: Every wall
options.text: All walls can break, thin ones fast, thick ones slowly.

cards.title: Enemies breaking walls
cards.text: Should some enemies break cracked walls too?
cards.why: A wall you hid behind stops being safe, and the maze slowly opens up during a run.
cards.pick: Later: one heavy enemy type breaks them when it comes. Mites don't.
